description: On a 375px phone nothing is wider than the screen (tables scroll inside .table-wrap): home with its match cards drawn, matches with its rows, stats and a rival page, in English, Spanish and Portuguese

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#match-list .match'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return document.querySelectorAll('#match-list .match').length > 0; })()

(() => { const W = document.documentElement.clientWidth; return ![...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].some((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width && r.right > W + 1 && !e.closest('.table-wrap'); }); })()
